description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically within the Administration module, providing functionality related to repairing or cleaning XSS vulnerabilities in SugarBean tables. It includes utility functions for cleaning beans and code for rendering the administrative UI interface for this repair process.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used to generate HTML output in the admin interface, instantiated for rendering the RepairXSS template.

methods.name: cleanAllBeans
methods.description: A placeholder function intended to clean all SugarBean tables of XSS, meant to be called from scheduled tasks or automation.
